items.title: Progress bar is invisible on loading screen
items.what: In the first screenshot, the horizontal bar under 'Downloading the game' is a 1-2px dark brown line on near-black with no visible fill or track.
items.why: Mobile users get zero feedback on whether the game is still downloading or frozen, increasing abandonment before the first screen.
items.how: Make the bar 6-8px tall, use bright warm gold (#C9A227) for both track and fill, and add a small centered percentage label in matching gold.

items.title: Fighters are tiny due to excessive empty space above
items.what: In every arena view (pre-fight qualifier, in-fight, win screen, etc.), the two characters sit in the bottom 35-40% of the frame with large empty tatami and window areas above their heads.
items.why: On 390px portrait, the core action is too small to read or anticipate moves, especially during fast exchanges or hits.
items.how: Raise the 3D camera target or tighten the vertical frustum so fighters occupy the middle third of the screen while preserving the low cinematic angle.

items.title: Virtual sticks are too small for accurate thumb input
items.what: The two bottom circular pads (STANCE left, TECHNIQUE right) are ~90-100px diameter with thin gold borders and sit flush against the screen edge in all fight screens.
items.why: Players will fat-finger or miss directional inputs during live bouts on a phone, directly causing lost points and frustration.
items.how: Increase each stick to 130-140px diameter, add 12px edge padding, enlarge the center touch zone, and add a brighter press highlight ring.

items.title: Techniques list uses unreadable small text and icons
items.what: In the MOVES panel (screenshot 5), each row has tiny ~12px icons, 11-12px font for names like 'Lunge Punch', and minimal row padding on dark brown.
items.why: Players cannot quickly scan or tap the correct move on a small screen, making the list useless as a reference during or before fights.
items.how: Bump body text to 15px, icons to 22px, add 12px vertical padding per row, and widen the panel or use larger tap targets.

items.title: Move callouts cover the fighters at key moments
items.what: In the in-fight screenshot with 'LUNGE PUNCH' (and similar 'FRONT KICK', 'IPPON' overlays), the dark rounded banner sits directly across the characters' upper bodies.
items.why: Players cannot see the actual animation or timing of the move being called, breaking visual feedback during the most important moments.
items.how: Move callout text to a thin top banner above the score bar or use a compact floating label anchored to the performing fighter instead of screen-center overlay.
